$comment: City sounds and the ambient score generated locally with Stable Audio 3 (sa3: model sm-sfx, `model` medium for the score; ~/.claude/skills/local-music). `python3 tools/audio/build_sa3.py` renders each take (cached in build/audio-sa3/), trims it, makes loops seamless with an equal-power crossfade of the tail over the head, and writes art/external/audio/<name>.opus; then `npm run audio`. One take per sound was picked from seeds 11-13 by measurement (steady level for loops, a clean swell for one-shots); the others are listed for re-picking by ear.

sounds.name: monorail-run
sounds.prompt: electric monorail train running on an elevated track, steady electric motor whine, rubber tyres rolling on a concrete beam, low rumble, continuous, no horn, no announcement

sounds.name: flyer-hum
sounds.prompt: futuristic hovering aircraft engine, smooth electric ducted fan hum, soft turbine whine, steady continuous drone, no jet roar

sounds.name: ac-hum
sounds.prompt: outdoor air conditioning condenser units humming on building walls, electric fan drone, faint rattle and dripping, steady continuous

sounds.name: siren-far-a
sounds.prompt: distant emergency siren wailing far away across a big city at night, echoing between buildings, rising and falling

sounds.name: siren-far-b
sounds.prompt: distant emergency siren wailing far away across a big city at night, echoing between buildings, rising and falling

sounds.name: score-a
sounds.prompt: barely there ambient soundscape, long sustained warm synth pad chords that slowly drift and overlap, very slow, sparse, soft, distant, deep reverb, melancholic night city mood, no rhythm, no drums, no melody
sounds.negative: drums, percussion, beat, pulse, rhythm, arpeggio, vocals, lead melody, bright, loud

sounds.name: score-b
sounds.prompt: very subtle slow ambient score for a rainy neon city at night, soft warm analog synth pads, gentle evolving chords, distant reverb, calm and melancholic, minimal, no drums, no percussion, no lead melody
sounds.negative: drums, percussion, beat, vocals, lead melody, bright, loud
